journey: Restore a saved Factory script on iOS
app: Factory Video Studio, Kotlin Toolchain iOS target

results.action: Open Factory app and verify empty workspace
results.comment: The Factory home screen appeared with an empty workspace.

commands: Simulator accessibility click: Start a script

results.action: Enter Saved iOS draft in Script title
commands: Simulator accessibility typeText: Saved iOS draft

results.action: Enter A script restored on iOS in Your words
commands: Simulator accessibility typeText: A script restored on iOS

results.action: Verify Saved on this device status

commands: Simulator accessibility click: Done for now
